competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 35% chance and provoke for 1 turn with a 35% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to decrease its Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance each. Recovers your HP by 15% when attacking an enemy granted with a harmful effect.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

effets.note: When attacking an enemy granted with a harmful effect.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

effets.note: When attacking an enemy granted with a harmful effect.

competences.description: Grants the Counterattack effect on yourself for 1 turn and attacks the enemy target 2 times to increase its chances of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns. And then attacks all enemies to provoke them for 1 turn.

effets.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.
